title: Very-High-Density Diffuse Optical Tomography System Validation Dataset
description: This dataset includes multimodal neuroimaging data from 8 participants who completed functional localizer and movie-viewing tasks using both Very High Density Diffuse Optical Tomography (VHD-DOT) and fMRI. VHD-DOT data are provided in SNIRF format, while fMRI data are provided in NIFTI format, with preprocessed fMRI data available in the derivatives folder for comparison purposes. The dataset supports validation of VHD-DOT as a functional brain mapping technique against fMRI.
methods_description: Participants underwent multiple sessions: Sessions 1 and 2 involved VHD-DOT data collection (SNIRF format), while sessions 3 and beyond involved fMRI data collection (NIFTI format) during functional localizer and movie-viewing tasks.
